title: Netanyahu says pilot arrested after stabbing fellow pilot and apparently trying to crash Israel-bound plane – latest
summary_full: Israeli PM issues statement on flydubai incident, which saw plane plummet mid-air before emergency landing in Saudi ArabiaFull report: Pilot on Israel-bound plane stabbed co-pilot and tried to crash aircraft, passenger saysNetanyahu said one of the FlyDubai pilots stabbed his fellow pilot and intended to crash the plane.He added that one of the passengers on the flight managed to break into the cockpit with one of the crew members, and together they “neutralised” the attacking pilot.Almost all the passengers on the flight were Israelis. During the flight, as they were approaching Israel, one of the pilots stabbed the other pilot, and it appears he was attempting to crash the plane with everyone on board.” Continue reading...
